Subject: Next steps: security intake & SIG kickoff for Finovate

Alex / Maria — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Scope confirmed: payment processing flows, customer PII, and transactional metadata (no PHI in current scope).
- Desired compliance: GDPR data subject handling, SOC 2 attestation for the platform, potential HIPAA support if you later ingest PHI.
- Environment preference: you indicated interest in Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or a Private deployment for data residency.

Immediate asks / next steps: 
1) I attached a short SIG starter spreadsheet that captures the minimum items our security team needs to begin the SIG/CAIQ kickoff. Can you fill columns A–D with point-of-contact(s) and upload any existing vendor questionnaire exports? (attachment: finovate-sig-starter.xlsx)
2) Please confirm whether you need a BAA today or if HIPAA discussion can be scoped for Phase 2.
3) Procurement asked for our SOC 2 report and a high-level network diagram to begin authorization — I attached a procurement summary you can forward.

I'll loop in our Security engineer (Hannah) and AE (Jonas) on any technical follow-ups. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute SIG kickoff to walk through the starter and align scope. Proposed slots: Wed 4/1 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 4/2 09:00–09:30 PT.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have your completed starter.

—Camila Reyes

Camila — thanks for the recap and for the starter doc. A few clarifying questions before we populate: 

1) SOC 2: Is Redwood currently SOC 2 Type II compliant? We need the report and date range for our vendor team.
2) HIPAA: We currently do not send PHI today, but HIPAA is likely in-scope for a later product line. Do you require a signed BAA prior to Dedicated/Private discussions, or can that be negotiated as part of procurement?
3) Hosting/residency: our compliance team needs to confirm whether a Redwood Hosted deployment can be restricted to a US-only region, or if Dedicated/Private is required for strict residency.
4) CAIQ vs SIG: do you prefer we export an existing security questionnaire to the SIG starter, or are you OK with us filling the starter directly?

I'm attaching our internal procurement checklist and an export of the vendor questionnaire we use (we can adapt whichever you prefer). Also — do you have a point person at Redwood for encryption/KMS questions? Maria will own the technical answers from our side.

Best,
Alex

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: security intake & SIG kickoff for Finovate

Camila — drafting suggested answers below you can paste into the starter / reply to Alex: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) in Nov 2025. We can provide the attestation and a redacted report for procurement.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA controls on Dedicated and Private deployments. We offer a standard BAA for customers who will process PHI; hosting on our Redwood Hosted (multi-tenant) tier is not HIPAA-covered by default.
- Data residency: Dedicated and Private allow explicit region pinning and VPC controls; for Hosted we can constrain to US regions but recommend Dedicated for strict residency and compliance guarantees.
- SIG/CAIQ: We accept both CAIQ exports and the SIG starter — whichever is easier for the customer. The starter is just to accelerate scoping.
- Encryption/KMS: All data at rest is encrypted with customer-optional KMS integration for Dedicated/Private. Transport uses TLS 1.2+. Audit logs and token-level usage traces available via the Console (retention configurable).

Hannah — please add any technical gaps I missed (network boundaries, egress controls, key rotation cadence).

Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Alex / Maria — combining answers from our security/EQEs below and attaching the filled starter skeleton to speed you up. Please confirm if you want us to accept your CAIQ export or if you'll complete the attached.

Short answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (Security) — report available and attached upon NDA.
- HIPAA: We can proceed without a BAA for initial discovery. For PHI processing we will require a BAA and Dedicated/Private deployment; we can draft a standard BAA when you are ready.
- Residency: Dedicated or Private is recommended for strict US-only residency. Hosted can be constrained to US regions but does not provide the same isolation guarantees.
- SIG/CAIQ: Either works. If helpful, we can accept your exported CAIQ and import answers into our starter — welcome to send the export.

Next actions: 
1) Alex — please reply with which questionnaire you prefer (CAIQ export or our starter) and whether procurement needs the SOC 2 first or the network diagram (we can put both in a single packet).
2) If you want the kickoff call, Wed 4/1 10:00 PT works for us — I scheduled a provisional invite.
3) I'll attach the procurement packet and the starter (attached). If procurement needs a redacted SOC 2 report before the kickoff we can route it via your security NDA contact.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Camila
